comment: Model warnings (P9): a rib 2 mm wide, 40 long and 20 high (F2.b0). Rounding all four top edges by 1 mm (a full round, the rib's ends rounded too) or bevelling them by 1 mm takes the top face away: since the OCCT port's patches 1652 and 1655 both build at their size, the top face gone (the end edges' dressups meet the long ones at the ridge's ends, the long ones meet on one ridge edge), with no information. A boss's top edge rounded with the boss's own radius (a dome) closes its top face to a point, which OCCT cannot build: the geometry builds it 0.1 % smaller, which leaves a sliver of the top face, and the feature succeeds with a warning that says so (mitcad#1783; before, information only, mitcad#1106). (The two long top edges alone build exactly since the OCCT port's patch 0950.) A real warning last: a plane at 90 radians.

The end edges' roundings meet the long ones where their cylinders cross: the top 1 mm at height t a rectangle 2 s by 38 + 2 s, s = sqrt(1 - t^2), so 19 pi + 8/3 of the slab's 80 mm3 kept. No face left on top (facing up), no information.
A chamfer as wide as the rib on all four top edges: at its size too. The top 1 mm at height t a rectangle (2 - 2t) by (40 - 2t): 80 - 42 + 4/3 mm3 kept.
The two long top edges alone: the full round and the bevel build at their size (port patch 0950), no warning.

A boss 10 across and 20 high (F7.b0), its top edge rounded by 5: the dome closes the top face to a point, which OCCT cannot build, so it is built 0.1 % smaller (radius 4.995, a disc 10 micrometres across left on top; the exact dome would keep 375 pi + 250/3 pi = 1439.897 mm3) and the feature succeeds with a warning that says it leaves a sliver of the face (mitcad#1783: the disc cannot be taken away, the faces round it cannot be grown to meet; information only where the sliver is taken away, mitcad#1106).

expect.error_contains: the fillet is built 0.1 % smaller than asked and leaves a sliver of a face it should take away: at its exact size the geometry kernel cannot build it

comment: Half the radius builds exactly: no warning or info.
A feature that succeeds with a warning (yellow in the timeline): a plane at 90 radians, an angle typed as a number of more than one turn (mitcad#714).
